[[Image:Drake.jpg|thumb|A Drake in Burning Steppes]]
[[Dragon]]s that are still relatively young in comparison to their ancient brethren. Drakes are always flying while moving, but the [[Dragon]]s are bigger and walks most while moving. You can find Drakes in the [[Burning Steppes]], [[Swamp of Sorrows]] and a lot of [[Dungeon]]s.
